current_activity: The 3rd Panzer Grenadier Division, falling back to Broichweiden, is hit by the US 120th Infantry before dawn
notes: Event date: CMH Siegfried Line Campaign ch. 21 p. 501: "At Broichweiden, a sprawling, loose confederation of four settlements a mile southeast of Euchen, the retiring troops of the 3d Panzer Grenadier Division had little chance to get set before the 120th Infantry hit them a half hour before dawn on 17 November"; ch. 22 p. 519: the division "held the urban district about Wuerselen". Event definition: the dawn of 17 November, after a withdrawal to the second line. Event support: one source family (CMH). Location: Broichweiden with a precision of 5 km; CMH names the settlement and its position a mile southeast of Euchen. Location approximate: a settlement point. Location support: CMH names Broichweiden. Commander: General Denkert. Opponents: US 30th Infantry Division (120th Infantry). Review (German Batch 3 follow-up, 28 October 2026, requested by Scott; inferred value; old value: operation_id OP-QUEEN; new value: operation_id OP-ROER-PLAIN): the claim is a Roer plain action of the offensive (ch. 21 p. 501, ch. 22 p. 519) inside the window of OP-ROER-PLAIN (16 November-9 December 1944), a child of OP-QUEEN, so the narrower battle replaces the broader link.
